name: Figma agent
desc: AI agent that creates and edits designs on the Figma canvas.
desc_zh: 在 Figma 画布上直接生成和修改设计的智能体
solves: Generic AI tools redraw your screens from scratch. This agent works inside the real file, using your components, tokens and design system.
solves_zh: 通用 AI 工具总在重画你的界面。它直接在真实文件里干活，用的是你的组件、变量和设计系统。
best_for: You have a frame open and need three layout directions, or dozens of files restyled to a new component.
best_for_zh: 画板已经打开，想一次看三个布局方向；或者要把几十个文件改成新组件。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.figma.com/release-notes/feed/feed.json and https://www.figma.com）。 Launched in beta on 2026-05-20 (blog date line); generally available on 2026-10-06 per the release-notes feed entry 'The Figma agent is generally available'. The 2026-03-24 post 'Agents, meet the Figma canvas' is a different thing: third-party agents writing to Figma files through the MCP server. The same agent later reached FigJam and Slides (2026-11-23) and dev mode (2026-11-19); these are the same product, not separate entries. Later in 2026 it is extended with agent skills (2026-08-13). Distinct from ledger entries Figma AI (2023) and Figma Make. The Verge also covered it on 2026-05-20: https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/934533/figma-has-a-product-design-ai-agent 首次公开日期来源：https://www.figma.com/blog/the-figma-agent-is-here/
